subject: EoQ check-in: CloudSail discovery recap & next-step confirmation
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alex Thompson <athompson@cloudsail.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@cloudsail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0000
Subject: Discovery recap + proposed next steps (CloudSail / Redwood)

Alex — thanks again for taking time earlier. Quick recap from our call so we have alignment and a clear next step: 

• Key pain: CloudSail needs predictable inference latency for their customer-facing search and chat features during spikes (holiday traffic window).
• Desired outcome: keep 95th pct latency sub-200ms for 1–2k rps while cutting per-token unit cost vs current setup.
• Constraints: existing infra in us-west-2, security boundary requires SOC2 evidence and KMS for keys, procurement approval needed for enterprise contract.

Proposed next steps: 
1) I’ll share a short technical notes pack and a pilot proposal (2-week proof-of-performance), attached.
2) Your side: confirm whether procurement needs a formal SOW or PO first, and share any blackout dates for December testing.
3) If procurement prefers a vendor questionnaire first, Ben can handle the SOC2 evidence and Neha will provide the KMS integration checklist.

Attachment: CloudSail_Requirements.pdf (technical notes & checklist)

If this looks right I’ll schedule a 30-min pilot kickoff for next week (suggest Mon or Tue). If timing’s tight at EoQ, we can push kickoff to early January but would like to agree on scope and procurement path now.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
T: (415) 555-0146
From: Alex Thompson <athompson@cloudsail.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + proposed next steps (CloudSail / Redwood)

Laura — thanks for the recap and the doc. Looks good at a high level. A couple quick clarifications: 

• Procurement will need a standard vendor questionnaire completed before contract drafting — I can send that over by Monday.
• We do have a hard freeze for production changes from Dec 22–28 but testing in a staging environment is fine prior to that.

Can you and Ben confirm that the pilot scope won’t require prod cutover during the freeze? If so, we’re happy to move forward with the pilot plan.

I’ll loop in procurement when I have the questionnaire.

—Alex
Alex Thompson
VP Product Engineering | CloudSail
athompson@cloudsail.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Thompson <athompson@cloudsail.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 13:24:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + proposed next steps (CloudSail / Redwood)

Alex — quick confirmation from our side: the pilot we outlined is staged-only and does not require any production cutover. We’ll run the workload against a copied dataset and use the staging cluster in us-west-2.

Neha will attach the SOC2 artifact list and KMS checklist; I’ll fill out the vendor questionnaire once you share it.

Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alex Thompson <athompson@cloudsail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 17:08:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + proposed next steps (CloudSail / Redwood)

Alex — looping back since I haven’t seen the questionnaire yet. Given the EoQ timing I wanted to check status of two items: 

1) Priority: Is this still a December priority for CloudSail (i.e., do you want procurement to accelerate ahead of the freeze), or should we plan for an early-January kickoff?
2) Procurement path: will they accept the vendor questionnaire first or do they need an SOW/PO in parallel?

If it helps I can draft a tight SOW for the 2-week pilot that procurement can review alongside the questionnaire — saves a step if they want both. Would you prefer I do that and share a draft by EOD Thursday?

Thanks — appreciate a quick signal so we can line up engineer time before the holidays.

—Laura
From: Alex Thompson <athompson@cloudsail.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@cloudsail.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + proposed next steps (CloudSail / Redwood)

Laura — apologies, been buried this week. Quick update: 

• Priority: still interested, but Procurement wants to close existing vendor items this week. That means they likely won’t prioritize a new SOW until after the Jan 4 return. So realistic kickoff shifts to the week of Jan 11.
• Questionnaire: I’ve attached the vendor questionnaire to Procurement’s note (procurement@cloudsail.com). Ben — please complete that; Procurement can triage once you return it.

If Redwood can hold engineer availability for a soft kickoff Jan 11–15, that would be ideal. Otherwise, let’s schedule a placeholder and agree a firm date in early January.

Thanks for the follow-up and for offering to draft the SOW — we’ll probably need that in Jan.

—Alex
Alex Thompson
VP Product Engineering | CloudSail
athompson@cloudsail.com

> Attachment: vendor_questionnaire_cloudsail.pdf (sent by procurement)
